title: Secure Cloud Operator - Verification and Visibility

mission_brief.situation: As a Cloud Operator, ensure the security and integrity of AWS resources.
mission_brief.mission: Verify the configuration of your AWS account and resources.
mission_brief.execution: Use AWS CLI commands to retrieve information about S3 buckets and EC2 instances.

content.concept:
Verification and visibility are crucial for secure cloud operations. Understanding how to use AWS CLI commands can help identify potential security threats.

This section reinforces secure, repeatable, audit-safe cloud operations using deterministic, read-only validation techniques suitable for any sandbox or production-like environment.
content.walkthrough:
In this lab, you will learn how to verify the configuration of your AWS account and resources using AWS CLI commands. This includes describing S3 bucket contents and identifying EC2 instance details.

The walkthrough emphasizes safe execution, careful observation of command behavior, and validation based on successful execution rather than the presence of specific cloud resources.
checkpoints: Verify that the correct AWS region is set
Describe the contents of a specified S3 bucket
Identify the details of an EC2 instance

lab.setup: Set up your workstation with the AWS CLI and valid AWS credentials.
safety: Avoid running commands with elevated privileges

elite_competence.role_simulation: You are a Cloud Security Specialist tasked with investigating an unauthorized EC2 instance.

bug_injection.bug: Unauthorized access to sensitive data in S3 bucket
bug_injection.symptom: EC2 instance is not responding as expected
bug_injection.fix: Remove access permissions and revoke credentials

pass_conditions: Correctly identify the unauthorized EC2 instance
Describe the security implications of the breach
Implement corrective actions to prevent future incidents
fail_conditions: Incorrectly identifying the EC2 instance or S3 bucket
Failing to describe the security implications of the breach

interrogation_questions: What are the immediate steps you would take to investigate the breach?
How would you implement corrective actions to prevent future incidents?
Can you explain why it's essential to regularly monitor AWS account configuration?

legal_context.allowed: Use AWS CLI commands to verify AWS account and resource configuration
legal_context.prohibited: Access or modify sensitive data without proper authorization

resume_bullets: Verified AWS account and resource configuration using AWS CLI commands.
Identified unauthorized EC2 instance and described security implications.
Implemented corrective actions to prevent future incidents.
